comments.text: Tests if the attack of fighter X hits the opponent (opponent_index). The hit-zone table of the move gives a target extent for the opponent frame; fighter_distance must lie in the reach window ($11bb full, $11d4 half). A hit sets hit_points,x to 2 or 1, then scoring_move and the hit_reaction of the opponent. A miss changes nothing.
Same facing: the attacker faces the back of the opponent, or turns its back
Hit-zone table of the move when the fighters face each other
